method: 30 accounts per casual/regular/heavy style, 45 days. Actual time-based service, auto route, once-only capped star claims, quests, journal, draws, gear, presets and selector commands. Same account/route/pull seed formula and style budgets as B3. No currencies, levels, unlocks, or rewards injected. Synthetic increasing clock; no wall-time claim. Missing milestones are censored at day 45.

firstAnyLegendary.method: All owned rewards at end of day, including route drops, paid invitations and selectors. No legendary salvage before first observation.
